title: The dichloromethane extract of Callicarpa longissima rich in diterpenoid phenols exerts anti-inflammatory effect via inhibiting the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Lian-Chun; Fu, Yu-Xia; Ning, De-Sheng; Yu, Ling-Ling; Zou, Zhi-Qi; Pan, Zheng-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物抗炎机制，涉及TLR4/NF-kB信号通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Callicarpa longissima is a typical Yao ethnomedicine that has been used to treat arthritis in China. Our previous study found that the dichloromethane extract (DCME) of C. longissima showed anti-inflammatory activity in vitro. However, the anti-inflammatory mechanism and detailed chemical composition of DCME remain unclear, which lead to the original interest of this study. AIM OF THE STUDY: The study aimed to evaluate the anti-inflammatory properties of the DCME from C. longissima and further explore the accurate chemical components responsible for this active extract. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The anti-inflammatory activity of DCME in vivo was tested with carrageenan-induced mice paw edema model. Its anti-inflammatory mechanism was explored with LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages model. The compounds in DCME were isolated by repeated column chromatography and their structures were identified on the basis of nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy. The anti-inflammatory activities of the isolates in vitro were also tested by suppressing releases of inflammatory mediators (NO, IL-6 and TNF-alpha) in RAW264.7 macrophages model. In addition, the molecular docking analysis, which evaluated the potential interaction between the compounds and Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) and nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB), was performed. RESULTS: DCME effectively alleviated the mice paw edema induced by carrageenan. In LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, DCME significantly decreased the production of interleukin (IL)-6 and tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) via inhibiting their mRNA transcription, down-regulated the expression of TLR4 and myeloid differentiation factor 88, inhibited the phosphorylation of alpha inhibitor of NF-kappaB (IkappaBalpha), NF-kappaB p65, and degradation of IkappaBalpha. Twelve diterpenoid phenols were identified from DCME, and they not only showed different inhibitory effects on the production of NO, IL-6 and TNF-alpha in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, but also could bind to TLR4 and NF-kappaB as analyzed by molecular docking. CONCLUSIONS: Taken together, DCME from C. longissima could inhibit inflammatory response both in vitro and in vivo, which is mainly attributed to the synergistic effect of abundant diterpenoid phenols through inhibiting the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, and might be a promising agent for the treatment of inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：长柄紫珠（Callicarpa longissima）是一种典型的瑶族民族药物，在中国被用于治疗关节炎。我们先前的研究发现，长柄紫珠的二氯甲烷提取物（DCME）在体外显示出抗炎活性。然而，DCME的抗炎机制及详细化学成分仍不清楚，这引发了本研究的最初兴趣。研究目的：本研究旨在评估长柄紫珠DCME的体内抗炎特性，并进一步探索该活性提取物中发挥作用的准确化学成分。材料与方法：采用角叉菜胶诱导的小鼠足趾肿胀模型测试DCME的体内抗炎活性。利用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞模型探讨其抗炎机制。通过反复柱色谱法分离DCME中的化合物，并基于核磁共振波谱法鉴定其结构。在RAW264.7巨噬细胞模型中，通过抑制炎症介质（NO、IL-6和TNF-α）的释放来测试分离化合物的体外抗炎活性。此外，进行了分子对接分析，评估化合物与Toll样受体4（TLR4）和核因子κB（NF-κB）之间的潜在相互作用。结果：DCME有效缓解了角叉菜胶诱导的小鼠足趾肿胀。在LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中，DCME通过抑制白细胞介素（IL）-6和肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）的mRNA转录显著降低其产生，下调TLR4和髓样分化因子88的表达，抑制NF-κB抑制剂α（IκBα）的磷酸化、NF-κB p65的磷酸化以及IκBα的降解。从DCME中鉴定出十二种二萜酚类化合物，它们不仅对LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中NO、IL-6和TNF-α的产生表现出不同的抑制作用，而且通过分子对接分析显示它们能与TLR4和NF-κB结合。结论：综合来看，长柄紫珠的DCME在体内和体外均能抑制炎症反应，这主要归因于丰富的二萜酚类化合物通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB信号通路的协同作用，并可能成为治疗炎症性疾病的有前景的药物。
